methodology.formula: exp(log(DD baseline) + sum(weight × clamp(log(source rank / baseline), -log(2), log(2))))
methodology.unlistedDD: National-list omissions do not create a DD rank. The 45 uncovered eligible players use explicit editorial ordering scores with 2026 performance, dated scouting, comparison peers and rationale. Original publication-consensus ordering is preserved among the 215 covered players.
methodology.missingSupport: Neutral. Weight never redistributed. Missing ranks never imply graduation.
methodology.eligibility: User instruction: non-debuted prospects only. Any recorded MLB debut excludes the player, regardless of remaining rookie eligibility. Inspect every roster slot; retain additional MLB eligibility checks.
methodology.movement: August-to-October movement mixes graduation, ownership changes, source coverage and a changed model. Org arrows only when organization identity is unchanged.
methodology.limits: Full candidate coverage, with 45 supplemental editorial placements and conditional profile projections. This is a working edition; coverage is not certainty. BA national list remains partly accessible. Dated grades are observations, not newly assigned October grades. No inferred EV, whiff, injury diagnosis or guaranteed role.
methodology.profiles: Two original paragraphs per prospect: verified regular-season results, followed by a conditional development projection. Selected dated publication tool grades are shown where reliably matched. Level totals are not double counted. Missing data stays missing.
methodology.supplement: Editorial ordering scores calibrate uncovered players into the DD-led field using level, age, production, contact/control, scouting and health evidence. These are disclosed Pipeline decisions, not publication ranks or an automatic statistical model.

components.elite: 60% best prospect value + 40% mean value of the top five (empty slots are zero).
components.topTen: Mean value of top ten, empty slots zero.
components.depth: Half count capped at 30; half count with value >=20 capped at 20.
components.ceiling: Top-five dated impact tool signal, adjusted by development certainty. Unknown grades use ranking value, never an invented grade.
components.proximity: Value-weighted top-ten highest verified 2026 level: AAA 1, AA .7, A+ .35, A .2, CPX .08, DSL .05; missing zero.
components.hitting: Mean value of top ten hitters, empty slots zero.
components.pitching: Mean value of top five pitchers, empty slots zero. Two-way players also count as hitters.
components.certainty: Top-ten development certainty from level, contact/control and sample size. Higher means lower modeled risk; no inferred injury diagnosis.

farmMethodology.certaintyFormula: 55 + level adjustment (AAA15, AA10, A+4, A0, CPX-10, DSL-15, unknown-20), plus up to10 for sample (400 PA/100 IP); minus10 for <one-third sample; hitting penalty 1.1*(K%-20) above20; pitching penalty 2*(BB%-8) above8. Missing season stats minus15. Clamp 0–100.
farmMethodology.ceilingFormula: Selected impact tool future maximum: clamp((grade-30)*2,0,100), multiplied by .6+.4*certainty/100. Unknown: ranking value. Mean top five with zeros for empty slots.
farmMethodology.normalization: Each component is scaled to its league leader at 100, then weighted. Composite normalized to the leading farm at 100; gap = 100 - index.
farmMethodology.tiers: Elite >=90; Strong >=80; Above average >=65; Middle >=45; Thin <45. Relative to this league and this edition.
farmMethodology.limitations: Transparent model-based power rankings, not a publication scouting grade or talent probability. Rank and tool inputs overlap intentionally. Dated grades, missing samples and the non-debuted rule affect results. No sum of organizational ranks. Farm index is relative, not WAR or an absolute MLB grade.
